Data Sheet
                                       AD5592R

   8-Channel, 12-Bit, Configurable ADC/DAC with On-Chip Reference, SPI Interface


FEATURES                                                (DAC) outputs, analog-to-digital converter (ADC) inputs, digital out-
                                                                             puts, or digital inputs. When an I/Ox pin is configured as an analog
►8-channel, configurable ADC/DAC/GPIO                                 output, it is driven by a 12-bit DAC. The output range of the DAC
►Configurable as any combination of                                              is 0 V to VREF or 0 V to 2 × VREF. When an I/Ox pin is configured
 ►8 × 12-bit DAC channels                                      as an analog input, it is connected to a 12-bit ADC via an analog
 ►8 × 12-bit ADC channels                                                multiplexer. The input range of the ADC is 0 V to VREF or 0 V to
                                                            2 × VREF. The ADC has a total throughput rate of 400 kSPS. The ►8 × general-purpose digital input/output pins
                                                                         I/Ox pins can also be configured as digital, general-purpose input or
►Integrated temperature sensor                                                                        output (GPIO) pins. The state of the GPIO pins can be set or read
►SPI interface                                                  back by accessing the GPIO write data register or the GPIO read
►2.7 V to 5.5 V power supply                                              configuration register, respectively, via a serial peripheral interface
►1.8 V logic compatibility (AD5592R-1)                                  (SPI) write or read operation.
►Available in                                               The AD5592R/AD5592R-1 have an integrated 2.5 V, 20 ppm/°C
  ►16-ball, 2 mm × 2 mm WLCSP                                       reference, which is turned off by default, and an integrated temper-
  ►16-lead, 3 mm × 3 mm LFCSP                                      ature indicator, which gives an indication of the die temperature.
  ►16-lead TSSOP                                          The temperature value is read back as part of an ADC read
                                                                 sequence.►AEC-Q100 qualified for automotive applications
                                                          The AD5592R/AD5592R-1 are available in 16-ball, 2 mm × 2 mm
APPLICATIONS                                                    WLCSP, 16-lead, 3 mm × 3 mm LFCSP, and 16-lead TSSOP. The
                                                          AD5592R/AD5592R-1 operate over a temperature range of −40 °C►Control and monitoring
                                                                           (TA) to +125 °C (TJ).►General-purpose analog and digital inputs/outputs

ir.schema_note: 正式 Gold IR；已通过独立来源审校和候选 simulator admission。ADI AD5592R Rev. H，Register Map p.35-52。该器件使用 SPI 16-bit command word；addr 表示 control-register selector，不是独立总线地址。

address_encoding.reserved_command_data_bits: 10:9 are reserved for control writes; logical fields below cover register data bits.

fields.name: RESERVED_10_5
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bits; set to zero

fields.name: RESERVED_10
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bit; set to zero

fields.name: ALL_DAC
fields.desc: Apply future DAC write to all DAC channels

fields.name: RESERVED_10
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bit; set to zero

fields.name: RESERVED_3_0
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bits; set to zero

fields.name: RESERVED_10_8
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bits; set to zero

fields.name: RESERVED_10_8
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bits; set to zero

fields.name: RESERVED_10_8
fields.desc: Reserved command-data bits; set to zero

registers.name: SW_RESET
registers.desc: Software reset command; write 10110101100 to bits 10:0; p.50

excluded_blocks: DAC_WR and ADC_RESULT/DAC_DATA_RD readback framing are excluded until SPI transaction timing is specified.
GPIO, power/reference and LDAC behaviors are deferred.
Direct-register harness does not score power-up delay, software-reset timing, or IO_LOCK cross-register side effects.

proofread_record.method: PDF text extraction plus page-level inspection of Register Map pages 35-52
proofread_record.erratum_found: not checked by an independent reviewer
open_questions: Confirm that the frozen harness can represent selector-based SPI command words.
Confirm reset timing and readback transaction sequencing.
Independent reviewer must verify reserved-bit policy and defaults.

stateful_semantics.software_reset: SW_RESET key 0x5AC restores register and I/O defaults; reset timing/visibility requires protocol adapter.
stateful_semantics.io_lock: GEN_CTRL_REG.IO_LOCK blocks later I/O configuration writes; not scored by direct-register harness.

admission_evidence.promotion_note: Promoted after source PASS and isolated candidate simulator PASS; protocol extensions remain supplemental.
